The ticket is **#88412**, and I've posted that as a reply to Hollis's message in #central-random.

I found it in #central-team, which Hollis is a member of. On 2025-07-02 Tobias raised it as a Tier 2 escalation: the gatehouse tablet at Door 6 was freezing on the BOL barcode scan. He first called the account "TP", then confirmed he meant Tansleigh Packaging, not Tansley Parcel. That makes this the right ticket and not one from the Tansley Parcel carrier-API incident.

None of this is a finance figure, so it was fine to answer in the channel and no approval was needed.
